notes.title: Awesome German Games Worth A Look!
notes.content:
Hey Tavernkeepers,
With the Games Forged in Germany Steam event running right now, we would love to highlight some awesome projects from several German game dev studios! 



We are starting with Toukana Interactive. The devs behind the indie hit Dorfromantik (which is currently 40% off 👀) have a very special place in our hearts. Their new game, Star Birds, is a relaxing asteroid base-building and resource management game developed with the team of kurzgesagt - in a nutshell. It combines the iconic kurzgesagt art style (and birds!) with deep gameplay systems. They have a demo up that lets you discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks, and guide your flock of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons! Time to check out the demo and wishlist this beauty![dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]

Another remarkable game is The Regreening by our friends, Positive Impact Games. The freshly founded team of German industry veterans lets you turn a desert into a flourishing green landscape in this cozy simulation game about healing the world. Restore animal habitats, befriend nature spirits, and regrow the wasteland. The art style is simply stunning, and the game gives you a truly wholesome experience in these challenging times. Wishlist this gem now!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419080?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]

Munich-based Jumpy Bit is making a game about making games while navigating the challenges of life. The Games You Make not only features exceptionally stunning art but also innovative, immersive simulation gameplay full of consequences to your decisions. Implement features that will probably break your game, hunt down bugs, and chase that mysterious thing called fun. Also, your mom may occasionally text you. Sounds like something to put on your wishlist?

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852750?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]

Cloudscrapers by two-person studio Nementic Games is a relaxing, minimalist strategy game that lets you build the highest tower, continuously adapting to the challenges and opportunities provided. Manage resources and upgrade your building tools to discover mysterious spheres way beyond the clouds. Even the occasional lightning strike can't hold you back! If cozy building sims are your jam, you will probably appreciate this one. Time to put it on your wishlist and sign up for upcoming pre-release playtests.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562200?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]

If farming on a boat that's a swimming animal sounds like something you'd like to explore, you can do so right now! Voodoo Duck has recently dropped a demo for Collector's Cove that lets you set sail on your customized friendly sea familiar (they have hats for it and you can cuddle it, too!). They frequently run playtests for their game to improve the experience and involve the community. So check out their Discord server for a shot at participating in the next. Until then, you can enjoy the demo and wishlist this cozy beauty. Hop on board!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2867470/Collectors_Cove?utm_campaign=ggdreamwalker"][/dynamiclink]That's all for now. Have fun with these awesome Games Forged in Germany, and see you around!

Your Gentle Trolls

notes.title: First playable demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
notes.content:
Hey there Tavernkeepers!


After months of careful plotting, writing, editing, drawing, animating, composing, coding and testing, we can now share the first playable demo of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker with you! 🍹 

And as part of the Games Forged in Germany Showcase, we will share new gameplay content in an exclusive trailer !

  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840060/Tavern_Talk_Stories_Dreamwalker_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
What to expect of the demo 
🌊 Cozy new setting: seaside tavern

📖 Whole new story (of course)

🕹️ ~30 minutes of gameplay 

🧙Introducing 4 new characters

⚙️ Revised mechanics for quest-making 🔖 and drink mixing 🍹 



You playing the demo is a big deal for us, but if you want to help even more, here is how:


How to support?

🎮 Play the demo: The more people download and play, the higher it will climb the free games charts  

✍️ Review the demo: This demo will allow for reviews. They can tremendously increase appeal and reach of the game. Every single one helps!  

✨ Wishlist and follow the game: Every wishlist and follow lets other players discover the game.   



If you are willing to go an extra mile for us you can greatly help us improve the game by filling out the survey about the demo. 

Demo Survey

📋 It will give us deep insight into your initial perception of the game, which is vital for us to make a game that resonates with you, the community. 

If you want to give us even more insights and/or excitement, hop over on Discord and join the conversation. 👾

Join the Discord



Being part of the Games Forged in Germany showcase and event is huge for us. There are many talented developers and incredible games from Germany that you should check out! 🥰 So take a look and enjoy this awesome event! 



 Games Forged in Germany 



Have fun and save sailing,  
Tommy

notes.title: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker joins the WDC World Ocean Day 🐋🥳
notes.content:
Hey Tavernkeepers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636931/0aa98de3b491ac6617cb5b3d4222d648c72d045b.png

We are excited to announce that we are part of WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation, for World Ocean Day!

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale on Steam, you will help WDC continue its global work to save whales and dolphins that are a fundamental part of a healthy, flourishing ocean.

You can check out Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker and find all amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/WODSale25

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC!

Cheers!
Tommy
